versionImpact.rationale: The new v0.2 alpha line adds a standalone public CLI and cross-platform binary distribution while preserving the Agent Hub protocol and non-certification boundary.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Linux x64, macOS arm64, and Windows x64 runners package and smoke-test the same public CLI as self-contained Node SEA executables.
Per-platform KFD-1 and KFD-3 witnesses, the bounded KFD-2 claim, checksums, manifests, and exact release-candidate roots are collected into a Buildchain Release Passport.
A declarative Buildchain v3 demo contract records the exact same-run standalone binary into independent native 1080p and 720p terminal captures and publishes receipt-bound responsive media.

summary: Publish Agent Hub Demo as a Buildchain-managed cross-platform binary and auditable animation reference.
